content.short: Bitfinex is a long-running digital asset exchange known for deep liquidity and advanced trading tools.
content.description: Bitfinex is one of the oldest crypto exchanges, offering spot, margin and derivatives trading with deep liquidity and advanced tools for professional traders. It is closely linked to Tether, whose USDT the Stable chain is built around, and Stable's official ecosystem page lists it among exchange partners.
content.meta: Bitfinex is a long-running crypto exchange with deep liquidity, listed in Stable's official ecosystem.
